$comment: The upstream this library tracks, pinned to the commits it was written against.
Run `node scripts/upstream.mjs` to see what has changed since, and
`node scripts/upstream.mjs pin <name>` to move a pin once the change is absorbed.
`paths` narrows both the log and the diff to the parts we actually mirror —
the rest of these repos (demo apps, appkit, MCP) does not concern us.

kit.why: The JS we embed. api/models is the surface the C# DTOs are generated from, and walletkit-ios-bridge is the model our js/src is built on.

kit-ios.why: The API the C# binding mirrors method for method. A change under Sources/TONWalletKit/API is a change our facade should follow.

kit-android.why: The second consumer of the same JS, and the model for our OpenAPI codegen. Useful as a second opinion when kit-ios is ambiguous.
